verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's own docs overview says it exposes stored documents and embeddings through conversational interfaces from a single API. Its product pages position it as a RAG retrieval layer and promise answers grounded in your content, backed by documented hybrid and semantic search with auto-generated embeddings. However, the evidence names no specific answer or chat endpoint and no reference documentation for it, and most of the conversational and RAG claims come from marketing pages. Missing for 10: documented conversational or answer API endpoint and its parameters, RAG retrieval workflow docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of conversational answers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can power RAG and conversational answers on top of my indexes with documented retrieval or answer APIs

citations.quote: It stores your documents and embeddings, then exposes them through fast full-text search, semantic search, and conversational interfaces, all from a single API.
Let users ask questions and get real answers, grounded in your own content.
The retrieval layer your AI applications need. Give your models accurate, current context from your own data.
When you configure an embedder, Meilisearch automatically generates vector embeddings for every document in your index.
